integrity: The proof derives the cyclic-subgroup fibers and commutation relation from the nondegenerate alternating commutator form on G/Z(G), counts orthogonal projective points exactly, and checks the formula by direct multiplication in finite Heisenberg models. Finite computation is used only as an independent replay.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to odd-prime extraspecial groups of exponent p.
Extraspecial groups of exponent p^2 and extraspecial 2-groups have different cyclic-subgroup structures.
The rank-one order-p^3 specialization was already known.
An equivalent arbitrary-rank formula could exist under symplectic-polar-space or permutability-graph terminology.
title: Cyclic-subgroup commutativity of extraspecial exponent-\(p\) groups
